name: Launch Schedule
author: Dean White
description: Upcoming space launches, live webcasts, crew, and a text-mode trajectory globe

barWidget.description: Rocket icon with countdown to the next launch; click for schedule, streams, crew and ground tracks

schema.label: Show countdown in bar
schema.description: Show time to the next launch next to the icon when it is close.

schema.label: Countdown window (hours)
schema.description: Only show the countdown when the next launch is within this many hours.

schema.label: Keep finished launches (hours)
schema.description: How long a launch stays in the list after liftoff. Launches with a live webcast or still in flight always stay; 0 removes the rest as soon as they finish.
